text:
You need a developer who can turn complex data into reliable reports, automate routine analysis, and document the methodology clearly while working in SAS, SQL, and BI workflows.

I’m Noor Halden, and I bring 6 years of experience building data-driven applications and analytical tools with Python, pandas, machine learning, and NLP. While my core stack is not SAS-specific, my background is strongly aligned with the kind of structured analytical thinking, data wrangling, and report automation this role requires. I’m comfortable working with data sources, transforming information for business use, and building dependable workflows with clear documentation.

One project I built was a contract clause search assistant for a confidential legal client. It answered questions across 9,000 contracts and always quoted the clause and page it used. That system achieved 0.91 faithfulness on a 120-question lawyer-written test set, and it reduced clause lookup time from 25 minutes to 3 minutes. That work required careful data handling, rigorous validation, and precise outputs.

I also built a delivery support chatbot for Parcelwise Logistics. It tracked parcels, rescheduled deliveries, and handed off to a human with full context through WhatsApp and SMS. That assistant resolved 43% of conversations without an agent and achieved a CSAT score of 4.4 out of 5. This project strengthened my ability to work with operational data, automation, and user-facing workflows that need to be dependable and well documented.

For your SAS role, I would bring a disciplined approach to data preparation, analysis, and automation, along with strong communication and documentation habits. I’m especially interested in work that involves translating data into useful reporting, applying analytical techniques carefully, and producing professional-quality deliverables that others can trust and maintain.

If you’re looking for someone who can contribute quickly, communicate clearly, and focus on quality, I’d be glad to discuss how I can support your team on this contract.
